title: Research: P112's nine-term COPY floor holds for every nonzero coefficient
head: 3fa1c93c8c66ada108336b99add7db927ea9fa1f
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

For the fixed P112 ports `(0,1)`, every nonzero complex coefficient in
`K_lambda=G-(G e_0-4e_0)e_0^T+lambda e_0 e_1^T` has sharp separate nine-term COPY-power minimum
`7*8^q+7^q+1`, for every `0<q<=1`. This extends PR2321's coefficient `+1` result; it does not claim its already established COPY64 optimum as new. Changing only this coefficient cannot beat the eight-rank-eight COPY-power benchmark.

The precise new obligation is the parameter transfer and its exceptional duality case. An invertible diagonal row/coefficient map preserves the complete support catalogue for every nonzero complex coefficient. The pairing `2+16/lambda` vanishes at `lambda=-8`, where a valid exceptional basis defeats the generic exclusion used at `+1`. A separate compensation case retains the sharp floor, and both a uniform attainer and the exceptional attainer are checked. The fixed-coefficient predecessor theorem remains intact.

Result kind: scoped written proof with an exact finite certificate, author-checked. The package is `research/p112-coefficient-copy-floor/`. No native supplier, full recursive moment, physical COPY sharing or kappa improvement is claimed. Frames, dirty restoration, global hosting/owners, precision/tape, all-size and analytic admission remain unchecked.

## Validation

CPython 3.12.3, standard library; Git 2.43.0. Passed:

```sh
python3 -I -B research/p112-coefficient-copy-floor/verify.py
python3 -I -O -B research/p112-coefficient-copy-floor/verify.py
python3 -I -O -B research/p112-coefficient-copy-floor/test_controls.py
python3 scripts/research_package.py --package research/p112-coefficient-copy-floor --check-only
python3 scripts/research_package.py --package research/p112-coefficient-copy-floor
```

Primary result: `PASS_P112_COEFFICIENT_COPY_FLOOR kernels=1022 lambda=nonzero_complex exception=-8 copy_sum=64 controls=8 no_new_kappa`.
Registered result: `PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE ... outcome=negative-result`.
Canonical receipt SHA256: `ca9b5b26f4571c08ec9f3163c9daf9c29ec9556be0b79797a220d203fb5bb289`.

The finite evidence includes 1,022 complete character kernels with annihilating bases and exact nonzero integer minors, 132 actual support-pairing ranks, five compensation-case profiles, and 25,088 polynomial endpoint coefficient entries. The coefficient argument is symbolic, not a finite sampling inference. The uniform and exceptional rational bases are checked against complete endpoints and support ranks.

Eight mathematical control groups cover the parameter boundary, wrong support transport/kernel, compensation omission, ordinary versus Hermitian transpose, the exceptional legal basis, and zero-cost duality. Nine CLI groups cover an optimized read-only Git-free export, source/receipt/type/schema/witness corruption and occupied-output preservation; a fresh generated receipt is semantically identical. All code uses explicit checks that survive `-O`. Patch whitespace checks pass.

Primary replay takes about one second; registered replay including controls about eleven seconds on the checked environment. The full selected cold replay, hosted CI, Lean, independent human review and all physical/all-size obligations were not run or established.

The registered replay was run again on the final package bytes before submission, under an 8 GiB memory cap: it passed in about ten seconds and left the worktree unchanged. I also checked by hand that the exceptional pairing `2+16/lambda` vanishes exactly at `lambda=-8`, that the floor gives COPY sum 64 at `q=1`, and that for q strictly between 0 and 1 the floor exceeds the benchmark `8*8^q`, because `8^q` is less than `7^q+1` there.

## Open next questions

Can redundant factors lower this family's COPY power? The smallest specific follow-up is `9x10` coefficient matrices `M,N` with `M N^T=I9` at `lambda=-8`, where termwise dual-basis exclusions disappear. Classify that compatibility before any physical synthesis. Coordinate with the active `lambda=+1` overcomplete claim linked above; its premise is distinct. README and TASK give the first step and blockers. No favorable redundant-factor or physical candidate is claimed.
